post.excerpt: This roundup blog post shares the latest new features and capabilities at Cloudflare. Learn more about how our cross-platform 1.1.1.1 & WARP apps now use MASQUE, a cutting-edge HTTP/3-based protocol, to secure your Internet connection. Additionally, DEX is now generally available.
post.title: What’s new in Cloudflare: MASQUE now powers 1.1.1.1 & WARP apps, DEX now generally available with Remote Captures
